newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek shares climb in strong volume, eye 1000pts.
newsitem.headline: Greek shares climb in strong volume, eye 1000pts.

text.p: Greek equities greeted the new socialist government of Prime Minister Costas Simitis with a move on the upside in high turnover with market watchers expectind a slow climb to 1000 points in the short term.

"The market stabilised after Monday's drop and I expect a moderate paced climb henceforth. The benchmark index is eyeing the 1000 points level, it is slowly getting close. The advance will be led by banks which have more to go," said fund manager Angelos Politis at Helvetia Funds.

"The short term target for the market is 1000 points but to see it consolidate there we will need clear signs that the government is moving fast to meet market expectations of spending cuts and privatisation," he said.

Noting that the market's view of the new socialist cabinet was positive he said he liked shares of National Bank, Ergo Bank and Alpha Credit Bank Cement stocks were also good picks on strong fundamentals.
The Athens general share index closed 0.82 percent, or 7.91 points higher at 970.77, below the session's high of 973.25 from Tuesday's 962.86 close after opening at 963.70 points.
Turnover rose to 11.17 billion drachmas from 10.77 billion on Tuesday on volume of 4.92 million shares. It was boosted by block trades in Keranis, Ergo Bank and Goody's.
